Definition: Word, speech, matter or thing — God's spoken word that creates, commands, promises and always accomplishes His purpose.
BiblicalUsage: By the dabar of the Lord the heavens were made, and His word 'shall not return to Me empty.' Israel learned to live not by bread alone but by every word from God's mouth.
TheologicalSignificance: Dabar assures us God's promises are not fragile. The word that created galaxies and sustained Israel still accomplishes everything God sends it to do.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Promises of God; Creation
